title: Frills of the Autumn
author: Sreetanwi Chakraborty
text:
You are not there in the frills of the autumn,
With dried leaves that have an imprint of our love
The fragrance of your cologne lingering across the
Recesses of the dark-chocolate night.
Have you touched the souvenir of your love?
In the holy Ganges did you leave promises to be kept?
Nights of the vaulting submission, hands that paint
The chiaroscuro of your love is dipped in honey-glazed
Fern bottles…
The frills of the autumn tear apart the sandpapered
Rhythms of the night,
When I converse with you
Mutilated in love, victorious in pain.
